text: In a town of 20,000 families, 40% families buy newspaper A, 20% buy newspaper B, and 10% buy newspaper C. 5% buy A and B, 3% buy B and C, and 4% buy A and C. If 2% families buy all three newspapers, find the number of families that buy newspaper A only.
explanation: Percentage buying only A = %A - %(A∩B) - %(A∩C) + %(A∩B∩C) = 40% - 5% - 4% + 2% = 33%. 33% of 20,000 = 6,600 families.
